summary: Frontend adds an Edit Profile dialog and a profile-fetch/register hook, and backend adds caller profile query + displayName update methods. However, backend registration is not idempotent as required, and an extra backend method (updateEncryptionKey) was added without being requested.

missing_requirements.requirement: Make user registration idempotent on the backend so that logging in multiple times does not overwrite an existing profile unintentionally.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend registration method shown (saveCallerProfile) unconditionally writes a new Profile for the caller via users.add(caller, profile), which would overwrite an existing displayName/encryptionKey. There is no conditional guard to preserve an existing profile when already registered.
evidence: backend/main.mo (saveCallerProfile uses users.add(caller, profile) without checking existing profile)

missing_requirements.requirement: Repeated sign-ins do not create or overwrite the profile when it already exists.
missing_requirements.reason: The frontend attempts to register only when getCallerProfile() returns null, but because the backend registration method (saveCallerProfile) is not idempotent, the overall system does not guarantee that repeated sign-ins/registrations won’t overwrite an existing profile if saveCallerProfile is called again (intentionally or due to client retry/edge cases).

hallucinated_features.description: Backend method to update the caller’s encryption key (updateEncryptionKey).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest only asked for reading the caller profile and updating displayName, plus idempotent registration behavior. No requirement requested a dedicated encryption key update API.
evidence: backend/main.mo (public shared func updateEncryptionKey(newKey : Text) : async ())
